title: Cell Enhancements
description: Settings for the cell titles and focus mode features.

showTitles.title: Show cell titles
showTitles.description: Display an editable title above each notebook cell.

commentAuthor.title: Comment author
commentAuthor.description: Overrides the name attributed to new comments. Leave blank to use your JupyterLab user identity.

showResolved.title: Show resolved notes
showResolved.description: Keep resolved (archived) notes visible instead of hiding them.

commentColor.title: Comment colour
commentColor.description: Avatar colour for notes you write. Leave blank to derive a stable colour from your name.

cellRounded.title: Rounded cell inputs
cellRounded.description: Give cell input boxes rounded corners and a soft shadow.

cellBackground.title: Cell background colour
cellBackground.description: CSS colour (rgba supported). Leave blank to use JupyterLab's default.

cellAccentColor.title: Active cell bar colour
cellAccentColor.description: CSS colour (rgba supported). Leave blank to use JupyterLab's default.

promptColor.title: Execution prompt colour
promptColor.description: CSS colour (rgba supported). Leave blank to use JupyterLab's default.
